ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image is a gray wooden block, with 5 numbered screws inserted above the wooden block, numbered from left to right as 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. In the middle below the wooden block there is a recessed empty area, and the left and right sides are solid parts. Screw 1 is located near the left external solid part, and screw 5 is located near the right external solid part; the rod parts exposed above the wooden block for both of them are relatively short. The tip of screw 1 can be exposed below the left side of the wooden block, while screw 5 has no tip exposed at the corresponding position on the right side. Reasoning: The problem states that among the 5 screws, 4 are of equal length, and only 1 is shorter. According to the comparable positions in the image, screw 1 and screw 5 are both near the external solid parts of the wooden block, and the lengths exposed above are similar. If they are of equal length, then in the corresponding solid parts there should be similar penetration performance; but screw 1 can pass through the left solid part and expose its tip below, while screw 5 does not expose its tip below on the right side. Therefore screw 5 has not reached the same total length as screw 1. Combining this with the fact that only one screw is shorter, it can be determined that the shorter one is screw 5.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram shows a wooden block with 5 screws. Four are equally long, and one screw is shorter. Which is the shorter screw?

method.method_draft: Use a direct pairwise comparison of screws in matching solid parts of the block. From the image, read the labels and observe that screws 1 and 5 are both near the outer solid portions of the wooden block and both show only a short visible shaft above the top surface. Screw 1, however, continues far enough through the left solid part that its pointed end is visible below the block, while screw 5 has no corresponding point visible below the right solid part. From the text, use the fact that exactly one of the five screws is shorter and the other four are equally long. Since 1 and 5 are in visually comparable positions but only 1 reaches through, conclude that screw 5 is the shorter screw.
